name: 海野六郎_武器別攻撃_6コマ_v1.png
decision: Do not normalize or deliver. Six full poses are independently segmented, but the raised katana tip in frame 2 makes the total silhouette about 547 source pixels tall while the standing character is about 430px. To fit 16px top margin and keep the ground within the 30_check tolerance, the common scale would reduce the character to about 170px tall, materially smaller than the 200px idle reference. No art is clipped; the weapon envelope prevents meeting both scale and margin at once. Move to a different task instead of shrinking the character.
promptSummary: Six-frame Unno Rokuro deliberate diagonal downward katana attack; wind-up, strike, follow-through, recovery; matching reference model and idle.
qaFindings: Visual review: six connected poses are distinct and weapon continuity is visible.
Component inspection: six independent full-character components; no cross-pose connection.
Frame 2 raised blade total silhouette height 547px vs roughly 430px for the body; same scale cannot fit cell height with 16px top margin and normal ground position.
Uniform normalization needed for fit would make standing character about 170px, materially smaller than the matching 207px idle character.
No normalized PNG, OCR, GIF, or Git delivery performed.
